tool.name: Transformers.js
tool.summary: State-of-the-art ML library from Hugging Face that runs pretrained models directly inside web browsers and Node.js with zero server dependencies via ONNX Runtime and WebGPU.
tool.architecture: WebAssembly + WebGPU execution runtime for ONNX neural network models.
tool.benchmarks: Up to 10x speedup utilizing client-side WebGPU acceleration in Chrome/Edge.
tool.limitations: Model size bounded by client browser RAM / VRAM allocation.
